answer_1.quote: In this work, we design a cross-task prompting setup (Section 2) using three different LLMs: LLaMA-2 7B and 13B, and GPT 3.5; we select 50 different pairs of tasks where one serves as a source (i.e., context example task) and the other as target.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include predicted labels such as True/False, multiple-choice answers (A/B/C/D), sentiment labels (positive/negative/neutral), POS tags, named entity tags, and entailment/contradiction/neutral for NLI.
